annotation: The participant turned their head quickly from left to right, gave a small wave with their left hand, and glanced downwards.
The participant leaned forward, shifted their posture, and placed their hands in their front pockets.
The participant leaned forward, their jaw dropped.
The participant raised both hands, swayed from side to side, and closed their eyes slightly.
The participant leaned back slightly, covered their mouth with both hands, and smiled broadly.
